events.name: Chicago White Sox at Baltimore Orioles

headlines.description: — Colson Montgomery and Junior Perez homered during Chicago's seven-run third inning and the White Sox pounded the Baltimore Orioles 9-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: White Sox score 7 runs before making an out in the 3rd, pound the Orioles 9-3

headlines.description: — Cristopher Sánchez returned to form after a couple of shaky outings, allowing only three hits in seven innings as the Philadelphia Phillies beat the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-0 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sánchez fans 9 in 7 innings, becomes 1st starter to reach 10 wins in 8-0 victory over Pirates

headlines.description: — Jacob deGrom pitched seven strong innings and the Texas Rangers took advantage of a bone-headed play by Cleveland rookie outfielder Cooper Ingle on...
headlines.shortLinkText: Jacob deGrom dominant for 7 innings, streaking Rangers get gift run in 4-2 win over Guardians

events.name: Detroit Tigers at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Tarik Skubal pitched six innings of one-hit ball and Riley Greene hit two of Detroit's four homers off Cam Schlittler as the Tigers beat the Yankees 9-3 on Tuesday night and sent New York to its season-worst sixth straight loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Skubal works 6 strong innings, Tigers hit 5 homers in 9-3 win over the Yankees

events.name: New York Mets at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Nolan McLean and three relievers combined on a six-hitter, Francisco Alvarez and Luis Torrens both hit solo home runs and the New York Mets beat the Toronto Blue Jays 3-0 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: McLean and 3 relievers combine on six-hitter, Alvarez and Torrens homer as Mets beat Blue Jays 3-0

events.name: Washington Nationals at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: - Cade Cavalli gave up one hit in seven innings and had a career-high 13 strikeouts in the Washington Nationals' 8-1 victory over the Red Sox on Tuesday night, snapping Boston's five-game winning streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cavalli strikes out 13, Nationals snap Red Sox's 5-game win streak with 8-1 rout

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Atlanta Braves

headlines.description: — Nathan Church hit a three-run homer, Nelson Velázquez added a solo shot and Matthew Liberatore threw five strong innings as the St. Louis Cardinals beat the NL East-leading Atlanta Braves 5-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Church and Velázquez homer, helping Cardinals beat free-falling Braves 5-3

headlines.description: — Jake Bauers went 3 for 4 with a homer and Jackson Chourio also went deep in the Milwaukee Brewers’ 7-2 victory over the Cincinnati Reds on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jake Bauers and Jackson Chourio homer in Brewers' 7-2 victory over Reds

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Junior Caminero homered for the fifth straight game, a three-run shot that highlighted a six-run second inning, and the Tampa Bay Rays rolled from there to a 10-4 victory over the Kansas City Royals on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Junior Caminero homers for the 5th straight game as the Rays beat the Royals 10-4 in series opener

events.name: San Diego Padres at Chicago Cubs

headlines.description: — Dansby Swanson hit two of Chicago’s five home runs and the Cubs held on for their fourth straight victory, 9-7 over the San Diego Padres on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dansby Swanson hits 2 of Chicago's 5 HRs as the Cubs beat the Padres 9-7

headlines.description: — Yordan Alvarez's grand slam highlighted a six-run fourth inning and the Houston Astros beat the Minnesota Twins 6-4 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alvarez's grand slam highlights 6-run inning as the Astros beat the Twins 6-4

headlines.description: — Javier Sanoja and Owen Caissie each hit three-run homers, and Joe Mack added a two-run shot as the Miami Marlins defeated the Colorado Rockies 14-3 to claim their franchise-best 20th win of June.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sanoja, Caissie and Mack homer as Marlins dismantle Rockies 14-3 for franchise-best 20th win of June

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Seattle Mariners

headlines.description: — Julio Rodriguez had three hits and scored twice, Bryan Woo took a shutout into the seventh inning and the Seattle Mariners put together a five-run sixth on Tuesday night to beat the Los Angeles Angels 8-3.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mariners have big sixth inning to back Woo in an 8-3 victory over the Angels

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at Athletics Athletics

headlines.description: — Tommy Edman had four hits including his first home run of the season, and Dave Roberts became the fastest manager in history to reach 1,000 career wins after the Los Angeles Dodgers beat the Athletics 9-3 on Tuesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Edman homers, Roberts earns 1,000th managerial win as Dodgers beat A's 9-3

events.name: San Francisco Giants at Arizona Diamondbacks

headlines.description: — Ketel Marte homered in his fourth straight game, Lourdes Gurriel Jr. added a three-run homer and the Arizona Diamondbacks extended their dominance against the San Francisco Giants with a 8-2 win on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ketel Marte homers in his 4th straight game, D-backs extend dominance over Giants with 8-2 win
